notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes – First Update Since "Steven" Release!
notes.content:
[h1]🛠 Patch Notes – First Update Since "Steven" Release![/h1]

Hello everyone!

We’re excited to bring you the first major update since the release of [b]"Steven"[/b]! This update introduces several new features, improvements, and quality-of-life changes based on your feedback.

[h2]✨ New Features & Additions[/h2]

[list]
[*]🎮 [b]Controller support[/b] added for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*]🎵 [b]New music track[/b] to enhance the atmosphere.
[*]🏆 [b]New achievement[/b]: "Labor Force" — can you unlock it?
[*]🌍 [b]Translations[/b] now available in:
[list]
[*]Russian (ru)
[*]Polish (pl)
[*]Portuguese – Portugal (pt-PT)
[*]Portuguese – Brazil (pt-BR)
[*]Spanish (es)
[*]Chinese (zh)
[*]French (fr)
[*]German (de)
[*]Turkish (tr)
[*]Japanese (jp)
[*]Korean (kr)
[*]Italian (it)
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]🧩 User Interface Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*]🧩 [b]Upgrade menu[/b] redesigned for better usability.
[*]⇧ [b]Hold Shift[/b] in-game to quickly open the upgrade menu.
[*]📊 [b]Leaderboard interface[/b] updated for improved clarity and style.
[/list]

[h2]🛠 Gameplay Tools[/h2]

[list]
[*]🛠️ [b]Cheat mode options[/b] are now available for testing and fun.
[/list]

[h2]🔁 Balance & Mechanics[/h2]

[list]
[*]🌀 The [b]"Featherstorm" upgrade[/b] now triggers automatically for smoother gameplay flow.
[/list]

Thanks for playing and supporting the game — more updates are on the way!

[i]– The Dev Team[/i]
